name: Monito
reviewNotes:
Studio site uses only "Monito"; full name from the James Lane Post opening article. Another site spells it "Gotchev".

Directory research 2026-10-04: No personal website or professional social page found; the website field is the studio's About page that features him. Bookings and contact go through the studio (organizer the-studio-by-hill-street already has phone/email), so no phone/email is recorded on the teacher. Surname spelled Gochev (James Lane Post) and Gotchev (Danznik, a 2016 YouTube video title); keep the alias. A TikTok @momchilb ('Just for fun') may be his but is not linked from any official page, so not recorded. The partners in the photos are not named in alt text.
description: Monito (Momchil Gochev) is the lead teacher at The Studio by Hill Street in Southampton. He teaches adults ballroom and Latin dances such as waltz, foxtrot, tango, salsa, bachata, cha-cha and rumba in weekly group classes and private lessons, and he also preps couples for wedding first dances.

photos.alt: Monito, in a light blue suit, smiles as he leads a partner in a red and black dress across the wooden floor of The Studio in Southampton
photos.credit: Photo: The Studio by Hill Street (website)

photos.alt: Monito holds hands with a dance partner in a ballroom pose on a sandy beach with the ocean behind them
photos.credit: Photo: The Studio by Hill Street (website)

evidence.note: Studio's About page says the studio is led by instructor, choreographer and pro competitor Monito; the photo file on this page is named after Monito.
Studio page lists the Latin (salsa, bachata, cha-cha, rumba, samba) and ballroom (waltz, foxtrot, tango, quickstep, Viennese waltz) styles Monito teaches, plus wedding dance lessons.
2025 opening article names the head instructor as Momchil Gochev, known as Monito, at 33 Hill Street, Southampton; its courtesy photo shows the same man as the studio's photos.
Danznik (NYC/Westchester) lists Momchil "Monito" Gotchev as a guest ballroom instructor with a flamenco background, confirming the alternate spelling.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: thestudiobyhillstreet.com, jameslanepost.com, danznik.com.
